description:
Create the new `octo_pi_tracer` umbrella app. It must have no internal umbrella dependencies so it can sit at the bottom of the dep graph.

- `mix new apps/octo_pi_tracer --sup`
- `OctoPi.Tracer` module with `register/1` (stores handler spec in ETS on `Application.start/2`) and `registered/0` (enumerates all specs)
- Handler spec: `%{id: atom, description: String.t(), events: [[atom]], level: Logger.level()}`
- `OctoPi.Tracer.Formatter` — single log-line format: `monotonic_us wall_time_iso [app.subsystem.action] key=value ...`
- `OctoPi.Tracer.FileBackend` — Logger backend (or OTP `:logger` handler) that filters on `domain: :octo_pi_tracer` and writes to a configured path
- CLI integration in `octo_pi_tui`: `--log-telemetry=PATH` installs the file backend; `--no-telemetry=id1,id2` detaches named handlers after startup; `--list-telemetry` calls `OctoPi.Tracer.registered/0` and prints id + description
title: Scaffold octo_pi_tracer umbrella app
